_comment: Cross-vendor review profiles. Copy this file to profiles.json (gitignored) and edit endpoints and models. All backends use OAuth; no static API keys go here. Ensure 'az login' (Foundry), 'gh auth login' (GitHub Models), or 'copilot auth login' (Copilot CLI) is done for whichever backends you use.

foundry-gpt4o._comment: Azure AI Foundry next-gen, OpenAI-compatible v1 endpoint. Recommended. No api-version needed (the /openai/v1/ path IS the version). Entra token scope: https://ai.azure.com/.default.

foundry-llama-inference._comment: Legacy AI Inference endpoint (/models/chat/completions). DEPRECATED - retires 2026-08-26. Use azure-foundry-openai when your model is available there.

github-o3-mini._comment: GitHub Models via gh OAuth token. Pick any model from the GitHub Models catalog.

copilot-auto._comment: GitHub Copilot CLI as the reviewer (uses your Copilot subscription). 'auto' lets Copilot pick the model; or specify e.g. 'gpt-4o'.
